freeze_and_readme.rule: commit 8981478 re-sealed the v2.5 freeze without a recorded authorization and is recorded as a deviation; S7 may re-seal README.md, docs/DATASET.md and docs/EVALUATION.md exactly once, changing no code, prompt, data or metric hashes, with one entry in data/annotation/v2.7/resign_log.json

budget.track_b: 200 new answers by seed order plus all v2.6-test overlaps; track B is not reduced
budget.fallback: if S4 estimate exceeds $16, reduce track A to 80 claims per subset; if still over, stop and report

ragtruthpp_license.attribution: cite the publisher blog and dataset card; state that no license was declared

conclusion_rules.single_comparison: write 'X is better than Y' only if the paired 95% interval excludes 0; otherwise write 'no evidence of a difference' and give the interval

track_b.metric: sentence-level F1 difference, optimized minus minimal
track_b.loose_win_strict_win: minimal is better and robust to annotation strictness
track_b.loose_win_strict_none: the ranking depends on the annotation standard; under the stricter standard there is no significant difference
track_b.loose_win_strict_loss: the ranking is decided by the annotation standard: minimal is better under the loose standard and optimized under the strict standard; choose by use case
track_b.loose_none: report both results; no overall ranking

conclusion_rules.track_a: independent conclusion: with claims given, which method verifies more accurately; do not combine with track B
conclusion_rules.readme: apply the fixed wording table; always report precision and recall separately; never use unqualified 'not worth it' or 'better method'
conclusion_rules.multiplicity: no correction, but state the number of comparisons in the report

track_b.license: not stated by the publisher; local evaluation only
track_b.match: exact answer text against RAGTruth response.jsonl; source_id, task, model and context recovered; stop on any mismatch
track_b.exclude_sources: all source_ids used by data/eval_hard.jsonl, data/eval_hard.v2.4.jsonl and data/eval_hard.v2.5.jsonl
track_b.reuse: response ids present in the v2.6 test split reuse the v2.6 predictions; all are included and do not consume the 200 new-answer budget
track_b.sample: first 200 non-overlap answers by rank, plus all v2.6-test overlaps

gold.sentence_gold: a sentence is hallucinated iff it overlaps a span in that standard

metrics.sentence: precision, recall, F1 under loose and strict gold; case bootstrap 10000, seed 20261024
metrics.answer: balanced accuracy under loose and strict gold (strict prevalence about 75%)
metrics.paired: optimized minus minimal on the same answers; sentence F1 and answer balanced accuracy
metrics.failures: all claims of a failed answer count wrong; excluding_failures reported separately

track_b.runs: one run per method per track

track_a.access: gated; the user must accept the terms and provide an HF token; anonymous parquet access returns HTTP 401
track_a.subsets: 10 LLM-AggreFact subsets after excluding its RAGTruth subset
track_a.sample: 100 claims per subset, drawn as whole documents; dev 10 claims per subset
track_a.input: one document per case; split passages at blank lines, else accumulate sentences to about 150 words, recording character offsets
track_a.mode: oracle: claims are given, no decomposition
track_a.metrics: balanced accuracy per subset and macro average; document bootstrap 10000, seed 20261024; paired optimized minus minimal; failures count wrong
track_a.leaderboard: recompute the same 10-subset average from the public leaderboard; state sample/prompt/subset differences

budget.basis: v2.6 test actual unit prices; track A oracle prices from v2.5 with a 2x long-document factor

notes: no prompt, verifier code, model or public gold change
track A cannot be frozen or run until the gated parquet is available
the v2.6 post-hoc sentence threshold 70 is not used in v2.7; threshold 60 is inherited
